title: The name input's profane words: res/name_input/profane_words.json
description: ARCID_PROF_WORD (a/2/1/6): PROF_WORD_LIST_COUNT lists of words that ProfWord_Check (prof_word.c) rejects as a name, in every language, each encrypted with PROF_WORD_SEED. tools/data/profane_word_data.py packs it.

words.description: The words, up to 31 characters each, in hiragana for katakana and capitals for Latin letters, as ProfWord_Check folds a name before it compares it

padding.description: For each word, the characters after its terminator, in hex, four digits each: the original's leftovers, which the game doesn't read; the packer cuts them or fills them with 0 to fit, and a word without one gets 0s
